full_judgment:
2. The writ petition was filed challenging the order dated 30-5-1999 passed by the respondent No.1 of the writ petition in Miscellaneous Case No.24 of 1998 arising out of money Execution Case No.11 of 1998 of Artha Rin Adalat No.4, Dhaka. The Habib Bank Limited instituted Money Suit No.48 of 1992 in Artha Rin Adalat No. 4, Dhaka for realisation of Taka 1,75,92,158.68 against Messrs Jute Fibre and Products Limited and its Managing Director and Director Yousuf Sad Uddin Ahmed and Mrs Maria Yousuf and obtained a decree in the suit for realisation of Taka 1,75,92,158.68 and put the decree into execution being Money Execution Case No.11 of 1998. The property of respondent No. 3 Mrs Maria Yousuf, one of the Directors of Messrs Jute Fibre and Products Limited was attached in the execution case on 19-4-1998. The Uttara Bank Limited filed Title Suit No.29 of 1999 in the same Court on 16-6-1999 for realisation of the outstanding dues amounting to Taka 9,88,165 against Mrs Maria Yousuf and Habib Bank Limited by selling the mortgaged property of Mrs Maria Yousuf. Thereafter, the suit was decreed on 17-11-1999 and the decree holder Bank had initiated title execution case. The Uttara Bank Limited on 21-9-1998 filed an application under Order XXI, rule 58 of the Code of Civil Procedure in the said Artha Rin Adalat being Miscellaneous Case No.24 of 1998 in Money Execution Case No.11 of 1998 filed by the respondent Habib Bank Limited. In that application it was stated that the property of Mrs Maria Yousuf was mortgaged to the Uttara Bank Limited, by depositing the title deed against the house building loan granted to Mrs Maria Yousuf and that property is not liable to be attached in execution of a decree obtained by Habib Bank Limited in Money Suit No. 48 of 1992 and that property is liable to be released from the order of attachment made by the Court. 

 4. The Artha Rin Adalat upon hearing the parties and considering the materials on record, by the impugned order dated 30-5-1999 rejected the Miscellaneous Case with a finding that the property has been attached for execution of decree which was obtained on contest and the property has been attached for realisation of the decretal dues of Habib Bank Ltd.
